Job Description: 701 Miller Family Services Support Coordinator (Case Manager)

At Avalon, housing is a human right. Our mission is to build healthy, safe and inclusive supportive housing communities as a long-term solution to homelessness.

Avalon Housing is a non-profit supportive housing provider. Supportive housing is a combination of affordable housing paired with services, such as case management. We don't just help people find housing, we help people stay and thrive in their homes.

If you are passionate about creating more diverse, inclusive, and equitable communities where all people are welcome, Avalon may be a good fit for you.

Using a Housing First approach, Avalon's Family Services Support Coordinators provide outreach, case management and housing support services to Avalon tenants in households with minor children. The individuals we serve face many challenges, including mental illness, substance use disorders, and/or chronic medical conditions in addition to chronic homelessness. Our clients live in Avalon Housing units, with private landlords or in public housing located within Washtenaw County.

Support Coordinators collaborate with community partners to coordinate delivery of a broad range of services that meet the mental, physical, psycho-social and housing needs of our clients, either through direct service or connections to appropriate resources.

Provide ongoing, active outreach and creative engagement to tenants
Conduct comprehensive assessments and help tenants develop action plans to achieve goals

Negotiate and advocate with external community resources providing medical, mental health, substance use, and other supports

Work to build community and peer support among tenants, including organizing community events and activities
Meet documentation requirements as dictated by program need

will provide high intensity housing search and housing support to help clients overcome barriers and access affordable, safe homes, to better their health outcomes. These supports are designed to increase housing retention. The Bilingual Housing Case Manager reports to the Program Director of Keys to Home.

Victory Housing Division provides life-stabilization services, intensive housing placement services and case management services to homeless families and individuals. Our program helps families and individuals obtain permanent, safe housing solutions, increase self-sufficiency, and gain skills which support housing stability.

Location:
29 Stanhope Street, Boston MA

Act in accordance with Victory Programs, Inc.’s Standards of Excellence always, including maintaining professional ethics, boundaries and client confidentiality.
Ensure that policies and procedures of the programs are followed.

Identify housing support needs; coordinate and advocate for appropriate support services and resources that will assist clients in optimizing health outcomes and housing stabilization, moving towards self-sufficiency.

Proactively plan strategies to appeal housing denials and present mitigating factors.
Attend all housing related appointments with clients, including interviews, appeal hearings, apartment viewings and lease signings.
Work with clients on accessing, obtaining, applying for resources related to housing search and support for maintaining housing such as income support, health insurance support, identification documents etc.
Develop a wide-ranging resource network for people living with HIV in the Greater Boston area. Provide coordination, linkage and follow-up with existing service programs to maximize access to services.

Summary/Objective

Five Stones Research Corporation (5SRC) is seeking energetic candidates to join our established and growing Huntsville-headquartered team. THIS POSITION IS CONTINGENT UPON CONTRACT AWARD.

Essential Functions

Responsible for the full execution, coordination, and quality of all work performed under the contract.
Ensures that all contractual requirements are carried out efficiently, accurately, and in strict compliance with the Performance Work Statement, while functioning as the primary liaison between contractor staff and Government leadership.
Acts with full authority on matters related to day-to-day operations and must remain accessible during standard duty hours to support Government needs and maintain continuous oversight of contract performance.
Directs all personnel, including Senior Network Engineers and distributed technical staff, ensuring effective workload management, quality assurance, and adherence to policies, technical standards, cybersecurity requirements, and established Service Level Agreements.
Coordination with the COR, CO, and other Government stakeholders; leadership of all transition in and transition out activities; oversight of emergency and contingency operations; and the management of required reporting, documentation, and performance metrics.
Accountable for personnel actions, training compliance, clearance processing, and Key Personnel requirements while ensuring no lapses in support or coverage.
Oversees issue resolution, escalation management, and continuous improvement initiatives, ensuring timely and accurate response to incidents, problems, and change requests.
Monitors trends, mitigates risks, and enforces a Quality Control Plan while supporting the Government’s Quality Assurance framework.
Executes strong leadership, exceptional communication skills, and the ability to manage a large, geographically distributed workforce in a complex, dynamic DoD healthcare IT environment.

Required Education And Experience

Minimum 12 years of professional experience in IT, network operations, program management, or related fields.
Minimum 5 years of experience managing a program or technical workforce of 40 or more personnel.
Bachelor’s degree in business, IT, Engineering, or related discipline.
Valid Security+ certification (or equivalent IAT/IAM cyber certification such as CISSP, CISM, CCSP, or other DoD approved cybersecurity credential).
Demonstrated experience supervising distributed technical teams and delivering performance in complex environments.
Strong background managing large scale IT programs, service delivery contracts, or network operations.
